Process review 2026-11-07 (slot `10pr-20261106T144527Z-1`, 100 PRs):
- Miss #6019 (lever 12): a sub-issue with "Depends on: <its own epic>" waited for ever, and the queue was idle 20.4 h. The owner fixed the case of a note in parentheses. PR #6050 fixes the class: `dashboard.blockers` ignores parent epics, and orphan tickets are now a refill source, so the pacer starts a run for them. `orphans()` already found such tickets, but only `cycle_start.py` showed them, and with no ready ticket no run started. That is the lesson.
- Step 1: the changes of 2026-11-06 (PRs #5963, #5986, #6011) have fewer than 50 merged PRs after them: too early, so they stay. The given-back share goes down: 13 of 146 run reports now, 15 to 16 of 131 to 137 before.
- Levers: 1 base 22 % · 2 phases read 20 %, verify 22 %, ci 39 % (ci is the quick-CI wait of `ship_pr.py` by design, #4784; read went down from 24 %) · 3 rework opus 4 % · 5 conflicts 16 / 100 PRs: `game/xs_host.py` 6, `docs/research/xs.md` 6, but no open ticket touches them (the XS work ended), so no change · 6 data 0 · 7 Unconflict solved 7 of 16 · 8 time waits 1 (#303, an outside event) · 9 owner chores 0 · 11 rework 1 % · 12 given back 9 %, idle 20.4 h (PR #6050).
- Expected: no idle stretch with an orphan ticket. The idle "no work" hours fall from 26.8 h per 100 PRs.
